\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{আরম্ভ} (ārômbhô)}{আরম্ভ (ārômbhô)}]{\bn{আরম্ভ} (ārômbhô) — a start; a commencement}

\label{lesson:BN-C329-arombho}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a summary, then the Bengali for to compose.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{আরম্ভ}}
\textbf{\bn{আরম্ভ}} — \emph{ārômbhô} — \textquotedblleft{}a start; a commencement\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{উপন্যাসটা} \bn{একটা} \bn{ঝড়ের} \bn{রাতে} \bn{আরম্ভ} \bn{হয়।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{upônyāsṭā ekṭā jhôṛer rāte ārômbhô hôy.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The novel begins on a stormy night.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{আরম্ভ}} (\emph{ārômbhô}) is Sanskrit \emph{ārambha}, 'undertaking, beginning' (Monier-Williams). It is more formal than \textbf{\bn{শুরু}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ārômbhô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ārômbhô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{upônyāsṭā ekṭā jhôṛer rāte ārômbhô hôy.} — The novel begins on a stormy night.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a summary, then the Bengali for to compose, then say \emph{ārômbhô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{আরম্ভ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A start; a commencement\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সমাপ্তি} (sômāpti)}{সমাপ্তি (sômāpti)}]{\bn{সমাপ্তি} (sômāpti) — a close; a conclusion}

\label{lesson:BN-C329-somapti}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to compose, then the Bengali for a start.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সমাপ্তি}}
\textbf{\bn{সমাপ্তি}} — \emph{sômāpti} — \textquotedblleft{}a close; a conclusion\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{গল্পের} \bn{সমাপ্তিতে} \bn{নায়ক} \bn{গ্রামে} \bn{ফিরল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{gôlper sômāptite nāyôk grāme phirlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
At the close of the story the hero went back to his village.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সমাপ্তি}} (\emph{sômāpti}) is Sanskrit \emph{samāpti}, 'accomplishment, completion, conclusion' (Monier-Williams). It is the formal partner of \textbf{\bn{শেষ}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sômāpti}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sômāpti}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gôlper sômāptite nāyôk grāme phirlô.} — At the close of the story the hero went back to his village.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to compose, then the Bengali for a start, then say \emph{sômāpti} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সমাপ্তি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A close; a conclusion\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{চিরকাল} (chirôkāl)}{চিরকাল (chirôkāl)}]{\bn{চিরকাল} (chirôkāl) — forever; for all time}

\label{lesson:BN-C329-chirokal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a start, then the Bengali for a close.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{চিরকাল}}
\textbf{\bn{চিরকাল}} — \emph{chirôkāl} — \textquotedblleft{}forever; for all time\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{গল্পটা} \bn{আমি} \bn{চিরকাল} \bn{মনে} \bn{রাখব।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ei gôlpoṭā āmi chirôkāl mône rākhbô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I will remember this story forever.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{চিরকাল}} (\emph{chirôkāl}) joins Sanskrit \emph{cira}, 'long, lasting a long time' (Monier-Williams), to \emph{kāla}, time: for a long, lasting time.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chirôkāl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chirôkāl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ei gôlpoṭā āmi chirôkāl mône rākhbô.} — I will remember this story forever.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a start, then the Bengali for a close, then say \emph{chirôkāl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{চিরকাল} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Forever; for all time\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অবিস্মরণীয়} (ôbismôrônīyô)}{অবিস্মরণীয় (ôbismôrônīyô)}]{\bn{অবিস্মরণীয়} (ôbismôrônīyô) — unforgettable}

\label{lesson:BN-C329-obismoroniyo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a close, then the Bengali for forever.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অবিস্মরণীয়}}
\textbf{\bn{অবিস্মরণীয়}} — \emph{ôbismôrônīyô} — \textquotedblleft{}unforgettable\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সেই} \bn{রাতের} \bn{গল্পগুলো} \bn{ছিল} \bn{অবিস্মরণীয়।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{sei rāter gôlpogulo chhilô ôbismôrônīyô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The stories of that night were unforgettable.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অবিস্মরণীয়}} (\emph{ôbismôrônīyô}) puts Sanskrit \emph{a-}, 'not', before \emph{vismaraṇīya}, 'to be forgotten' (Monier-Williams): not to be forgotten.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbismôrônīyô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôbismôrônīyô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sei rāter gôlpogulo chhilô ôbismôrônīyô.} — The stories of that night were unforgettable.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a close, then the Bengali for forever, then say \emph{ôbismôrônīyô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{অবিস্মরণীয়} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Unforgettable\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করা} (utsôrgô kôrā)}{উৎসর্গ করা (utsôrgô kôrā)}]{\bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করা} (utsôrgô kôrā) — to dedicate}

\label{lesson:BN-C329-utsorgo-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for forever, then the Bengali for unforgettable.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করা}} — \emph{utsôrgô kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to dedicate\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{লেখক} \bn{বইটা} \bn{তাঁর} \bn{দাদুকে} \bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{lekhôk bôiṭā tā̃r dāduke utsôrgô kôrlen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The writer dedicated the book to his grandfather.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{বইটা} \bn{বাবাকে} \bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini bôiṭā bābāke utsôrgô kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করা}} (\emph{utsôrgô kôrā}) puts Sanskrit \emph{utsarga}, 'a pouring forth, a letting go' (Monier-Williams), before \bn{করা}; to dedicate a book is to give it away to someone.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{utsôrgô kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{utsôrgô kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{lekhôk bôiṭā tā̃r dāduke utsôrgô kôrlen.} — The writer dedicated the book to his grandfather.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for forever, then the Bengali for unforgettable, then say \emph{utsôrgô kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Heroes and Villains to The Last Page}

\label{lesson:BN-R329-review-323-329}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for the hero of a story and a villain.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the hero of a story, a villain, a role, a holy man, a disguise
  \item a riddle, a trick, a trap, to coax, to get away with it
  \item a moral lesson, an outcome, a sin, to mend one's ways, to be forced
  \item amazing, supernatural, to imagine, a hidden treasure, to vanish
  \item a novel, a biography, a volume, a chapter of a book, a publisher
  \item a page, to translate, a manuscript, a summary, to compose
  \item a start, a close, forever, unforgettable, to dedicate
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The hero of a story? (\textbf{\bn{নায়ক}}, \emph{nāyôk}.) A villain? (\textbf{\bn{খলনায়ক}}, \emph{khôlnāyôk}.) A role? (\textbf{\bn{ভূমিকা}}, \emph{bhūmikā}.) A holy man? (\textbf{\bn{সন্ন্যাসী}}, \emph{sônnyāsī}.) A disguise? (\textbf{\bn{ছদ্মবেশ}}, \emph{chhôdmôbesh}.) A riddle? (\textbf{\bn{ধাঁধা}}, \emph{dhā̃dhā}.) A trick? (\textbf{\bn{কৌশল}}, \emph{koushôl}.) A trap? (\textbf{\bn{ফাঁদ}}, \emph{phā̃d}.) To coax? (\textbf{\bn{ভোলানো}}, \emph{bholāno}.) To get away with it? (\textbf{\bn{পার} \bn{পাওয়া}}, \emph{pār pāoyā}.) A moral lesson? (\textbf{\bn{উপদেশ}}, \emph{upôdesh}.) An outcome? (\textbf{\bn{পরিণাম}}, \emph{pôrinām}.) A sin? (\textbf{\bn{পাপ}}, \emph{pāp}.) To mend one's ways? (\textbf{\bn{শোধরানো}}, \emph{shodhrāno}.) To be forced? (\textbf{\bn{বাধ্য} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{bādhyô hôoyā}.) Amazing? (\textbf{\bn{আশ্চর্য}}, \emph{āshchôryô}.) Supernatural? (\textbf{\bn{অলৌকিক}}, \emph{ôloukik}.) To imagine? (\textbf{\bn{কল্পনা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{kôlpônā kôrā}.) A hidden treasure? (\textbf{\bn{গুপ্তধন}}, \emph{guptôdhôn}.) To vanish? (\textbf{\bn{মিলিয়ে} \bn{যাওয়া}}, \emph{miliye jāoyā}.) A novel? (\textbf{\bn{উপন্যাস}}, \emph{upônyās}.) A biography? (\textbf{\bn{জীবনী}}, \emph{jībônī}.) A volume? (\textbf{\bn{গ্রন্থ}}, \emph{grônthô}.) A chapter of a book? (\textbf{\bn{অধ্যায়}}, \emph{ôdhyāy}.) A publisher? (\textbf{\bn{প্রকাশক}}, \emph{prôkāshôk}.) A page? (\textbf{\bn{পৃষ্ঠা}}, \emph{prishṭhā}.) To translate? (\textbf{\bn{অনুবাদ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ônubād kôrā}.) A manuscript? (\textbf{\bn{পাণ্ডুলিপি}}, \emph{pānḍulipi}.) A summary? (\textbf{\bn{সারাংশ}}, \emph{sārāngshô}.) To compose? (\textbf{\bn{রচনা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{rôchônā kôrā}.) A start? (\textbf{\bn{আরম্ভ}}, \emph{ārômbhô}.) A close? (\textbf{\bn{সমাপ্তি}}, \emph{sômāpti}.) Forever? (\textbf{\bn{চিরকাল}}, \emph{chirôkāl}.) Unforgettable? (\textbf{\bn{অবিস্মরণীয়}}, \emph{ôbismôrônīyô}.) To dedicate? (\textbf{\bn{উৎসর্গ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{utsôrgô kôrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
